groups.saying_opens: فدعا بتور من ماء، فتوضأ لهم

notes: «شهدت عمرو بن أبي حسن سأل» : the asker is in the story only (rule 5); the one asked, Abdullah ibn Zayd, answers by acting, so he is the last link.

«وحدثنا موسى قال حدثنا وهيب قال مسح رأسه مرة» is a second isnad with a different saying (a single wiping); stored as saying 2 (owner ruling 6). Whether it is a separate saying or a wording variant is a judgement call.
